description: This file defines a React hook `useProgressiveExpand` and a utility function `createProgressiveExpandController` for progressive batch processing. It allows for expanding items (such as tree nodes) incrementally, respecting UI responsiveness by batching work and yielding with `requestIdleCallback` or `setTimeout` fallback. It is designed for use in React components to manage asynchronous, incremental UI updates in a controlled manner.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object to process a list of items in batches asynchronously, using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout as fallback. It supports starting, cancelling, and progress tracking.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that manages the UI state for progressive batch processing. It wraps `createProgressiveExpandController` and provides state variables and control functions to start, cancel, and monitor progress.
